# Frozen growing-page compatibility evidence

> **Save v9 (HC-1, 2026-10-23):** v7 and v8 saves are now cleared, not migrated, so the `v7-*` envelopes, their baselines and `legacyV7.ts` are gone. `v9-home.json` is the old `v7-home` data in the v9 shape (household, one ink allowance), kept as a rich save for round-trip and validation tests. The history below describes the removed files.

The `v7-*.json` envelopes were captured on 2026-10-20 using the unmodified v7 profile/save reconstruction and compiler. Each matching `-baseline.json` freezes the old decoded data, both members' compiled spells and (for the mid-fight fixture) the exact replayed battle state and events. The test suite reads these files and never regenerates them.

All three saves include current/archive Glyph versions, independent version records, open cells, a placed argument, exit settings, proof masks and a last-trip recap/tally. Mid-fight and doorway saves preserve distinct spent counts on two Draughtsman Sources and a Stoker Source. The doorway has one pending pick; the mid-fight action spends a charge when replayed. `pages.ts` supplies empty, distant signed, straight-chain and branching fixtures without a dense representation.

`measurements.json` records one cold Windows Node 24.19 desktop sample per size (milliseconds). These are phone-oriented safeguards measured on a desktop proxy, **not phone timings**. Bounds stayed linear through 32,768 entries (1.47ms). At 2,048 connected cells compilation took 3.65ms and Fair Copy took 521.54ms; `stepsOf` failed by 4,096 and compilation by 8,192. A 1,538-cell Fork/Bend comb produced 19,662 clusters in 485.37ms; compilation failed by 6,146 comb cells. The failure numbers are observed samples, not stable limits.

The import proposals therefore allow 8MiB UTF-8 text, nesting depth 64 (root depth zero), at most 32,768 entries in one collection, 100,000 aggregate object fields/array slots, 100,000 notation tokens, and 1,000,000 explicitly charged algorithm operations. The byte budget bounds parser memory; the aggregate limits bound decoded objects and sparse entries; the work budget allows roughly 30 operations per maximum-size collection. These are external input budgets, never live page geometry or per-chain limits. Text preflight precedes parsing; structural preflight precedes semantic maps/traversals; expensive import algorithms must charge the shared work budget before work and fail atomically. A resource refusal is distinct from corruption and must preserve the original saved text.

Before accepting long connected imports, E1 must replace recursive compiler walks, `stepsOf`, cluster flow-tree/subtree traversal and `stepShape`; cluster enumeration must avoid scanning all descendants for every bounded eight-cell candidate. Audit `resolve.runStep`, deferred continuations, cloning and serialization of nested Steps too. Revision's `walkInside` is recursive; its real 3–8 flow-cell validity limit stays, but hostile saved/temporary insides must be validated before recursive compilation. Bounds, Fit, export and view rendering must never enumerate occupied bounding area.

The sparse text contract is `@lattice 1 growing` followed by canonical `x,y TOKEN` rows sorted by reading order; header alone means an empty page. Dense ASCII remains fixed. v8 retains the sparse save field layout and excludes viewport state; v7 decoding belongs in a frozen `legacyV7.ts`, validates against historical member shapes, and preserves coordinates, keys and replay before admission to current data.
